name: Events Countdown
changelog: v1.6.2: Fixed 24-hour countdown ticker offset bug by targeting start-of-day (T00:00:00). When an event is tomorrow, ticker now cleanly displays hours remaining (e.g. '11h 38m 11s') without an extra day. Once celebration arrives, ticker proudly displays '🎉 TODAY!'. Also added unconditional cleanup of lingering 'Family Member' notes and synchronized detail modal live countdown.
